Citigroup Lifted Stake in Navient (Put) (NAVI) by $743,600 as Valuation Declined; Cypress Semiconductor (CY) Holder Honeywell International Increased Its Holding by $1.52 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Citigroup Inc increased its stake in Navient Corporation (Put) (NAVI) by 74.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Citigroup Inc bought 57,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.49% with the market. The institutional investor held 133,700 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.78M, up from 76,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Citigroup Inc who had been investing in Navient Corporation (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.60% or $0.225 during the last trading session, reaching $14.295. About 663,783 shares traded. Navient Corporation (NASDAQ:NAVI) has declined 8.93% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.48% the S&P500.
Honeywell International Inc increased its stake in Cypress Semiconductor Corp (CY) by 8.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Honeywell International Inc bought 101,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.02% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.33M shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.21 million, up from 1.23 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Honeywell International Inc who had been investing in Cypress Semiconductor Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $0.165 during the last trading session, reaching $16.125. About 2.19 million shares traded. Cypress Semiconductor Corporation (NASDAQ:CY) has risen 15.57% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.02% the S&P500.
